_note: Seeded pest/disease risk rules, compiled from DAE plant-protection bulletins and BRRI/BARI IPM guides (same public sources as kb/pest_management.md). Each threat lists the weather + growth-stage conditions that favour it, plus prevention, treatment and an indicative per-acre treatment cost (BDT). The deterministic engine scores risk from live weather + stage; the LLM never invents this.

boro_rice.name: Brown planthopper (BPH)
boro_rice.symptoms: Hopper-burn patches in dense, over-fertilized fields.
boro_rice.prevention: Alternate wetting/drying, avoid excess urea, keep field open.
boro_rice.treatment: Drain 3-4 days; if >4-5 hoppers/hill spray pymetrozine.

boro_rice.name: Stem borer
boro_rice.prevention: Light traps, Trichogramma cards, clip seedling tips.
boro_rice.treatment: If >5% deadhearts apply cartap or chlorantraniliprole granules.

boro_rice.name: Rice blast
boro_rice.symptoms: Diamond-shaped lesions; favoured by cool nights, high humidity, excess N.
boro_rice.treatment: Preventive tricyclazole at panicle initiation in blast-prone areas.

aman_rice.name: Brown planthopper (BPH)
aman_rice.treatment: Drain field; spray pymetrozine above threshold.

aman_rice.name: Bacterial leaf blight
aman_rice.prevention: Avoid excess N, drain after flooding.
aman_rice.treatment: No chemical cure — drain, stop urea, apply MoP.

wheat.name: Wheat blast
wheat.symptoms: Bleached spikes in warm humid spells.
wheat.prevention: Avoid late sowing (after Dec 20), seed treatment.
wheat.treatment: Tebuconazole at heading in humid warm spells.

wheat.name: Aphid
wheat.symptoms: Colonies on tillers before grain filling.
wheat.treatment: Spray only if >10 aphids/tiller before grain filling.

maize.name: Fall armyworm
maize.symptoms: Ragged shot-hole leaf feeding, frass in whorl.
maize.prevention: Early (November) sowing escapes peak; scout twice weekly.
maize.treatment: If >20% whorl-stage plants infested, spray spinetoram/emamectin into whorls.

potato.name: Late blight
potato.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions with white mould underside; destroys a field in 5-7 cool foggy days.
potato.prevention: Preventive mancozeb every 7-10 days from 40 DAP.
potato.treatment: Switch to curative (dimethomorph+mancozeb) at first lesion.

potato.name: Cutworm
potato.prevention: Hand-collect at dusk, clean field borders.

mustard.name: Aphid
mustard.symptoms: Most damaging at flowering; sooty mould.

mustard.name: Alternaria blight
mustard.symptoms: Dark concentric leaf spots in humid weather.
mustard.treatment: Iprodione or mancozeb at first sign.

lentil.name: Stemphylium blight
lentil.symptoms: Main yield killer in humid Novembers; rapid leaf drop.

onion.name: Purple blotch
onion.symptoms: Purple-centred lesions in cloudy humid weather.

onion.name: Thrips
onion.symptoms: Silvery streaks on leaves in dry weeks.
onion.prevention: Blue sticky traps, irrigation to break dry spell.

jute.name: Jute hairy caterpillar
jute.symptoms: Gregarious leaf feeding, defoliation of young plants.
jute.prevention: Destroy egg masses, clean field borders.
jute.treatment: Handpick early colonies; spot spray if severe.

jute.name: Stem rot
jute.symptoms: Water-soaked stem lesions in waterlogged fields.
jute.treatment: Improve drainage; carbendazim at early sign.

tomato.name: Late blight
tomato.symptoms: Dark greasy leaf/fruit lesions in cool humid weather.
tomato.prevention: Staking for airflow, avoid overhead irrigation.
tomato.treatment: Mancozeb preventive; dimethomorph curative at first lesion.

tomato.name: Whitefly / leaf curl virus
tomato.symptoms: Upward leaf curl, stunting; whitefly vectored.
tomato.prevention: Virus-tolerant varieties, yellow sticky traps, rogue infected plants.
